dct_title_s: Map showing Inland Waterway and New State Highway
dct_description_sm: Map covers area of the coast from Cape May City to Atlantic City. Map depicts a new state highway that runs through Cape May, Holly Beach, Wildwood, Stone Harbor, Peermont, Avalon, Sea Isle City, Whale Beach, Ocean City, Longport, Atlantic City, and Ventnor. Map also shows marsh and some road layouts.
